changelog: Affiliate portal: changing the payout IBAN now needs a step-up — the authenticator or recovery code when the partner has 2FA, else the current password (`src/lib/stepUp.ts`). The code goes through the sign-in doors' own `requireSecondFactor()` (now exported from `src/lib/auth.ts`), and a wrong password is charged to the sign-in password counters, so the step-up cannot be used to guess around the sign-in limit. `PUT /api/affiliate/me/payout-details` answers 403 `step_up_required` (with `method`), 403 `step_up_invalid`, 429 `step_up_locked` or 403 `step_up_unavailable` (SSO-only account without 2FA); the change is still audited and announced (#3734).

en: Partner portal: changing your bank details now asks you to confirm it is you, with your password or your authenticator code.
tr: Partner portalı: banka bilgilerini değiştirirken artık parolanla veya doğrulayıcı kodunla sen olduğunu doğruluyorsun.
de: Partnerportal: Wenn Sie Ihre Bankverbindung ändern, bestätigen Sie jetzt mit Ihrem Passwort oder Ihrem Authenticator-Code, dass Sie es sind.
